crew_onboarding_api_key_not_recognized: Error under the API key field when the engine still reports no sign-in after the key was written.
crew_onboarding_atlas_crew_setup: Accessible name of the onboarding dialog.
crew_onboarding_check_again: Button that repeats a check: for the ssh program, for an engine's sign-in.

crew_onboarding_connecting.description: Primary button label and sign-in terminal placeholder while Atlas reaches the server.

crew_onboarding_docs.description: Small link of an onboarding step: opens the docs page that explains it.
crew_onboarding_docs.distinct: the desktop onboarding link; the nav area belongs to the site

crew_onboarding_key_label_claude: Line under the Claude Code engine's name: which key it takes.
crew_onboarding_key_label_codex: Line under the Codex engine's name: which key it takes.
crew_onboarding_key_label_omp: Line under the omp engine's name: which key it takes.
crew_onboarding_key_label_opencode: Line under the OpenCode engine's name: which key it takes.
crew_onboarding_paste_key_claude: Title of the key form of the Claude Code engine.
crew_onboarding_paste_key_codex: Title of the key form of the Codex engine.
crew_onboarding_paste_key_default: Title of the key form of any other engine.
crew_onboarding_paste_key_omp: Title of the key form of the omp engine.
crew_onboarding_paste_key_opencode: Title of the key form of the OpenCode engine.
crew_onboarding_pick_key_title: Title of the operating system file picker opened by Choose another.

crew_onboarding_primary_add_crew_server.description: Primary footer button of the connect step: starts the install on the server.

crew_onboarding_primary_back_to_engines.description: Primary footer button while an engine's sign-in panel is open: returns to the engine list.

crew_onboarding_primary_engine_not_ready: Hint above the disabled Open chat button when the chosen engine is not ready; {status} is the engine's card badge in lower case.

crew_onboarding_primary_installing.description: Primary footer button label while the crew server install runs.
crew_onboarding_primary_installing.distinct: the footer button, not an engine badge

crew_onboarding_primary_not_checked: The {status} of the engine hint when the engine was never checked.

crew_onboarding_primary_open_chat.description: Primary footer button of the last step: opens the first crewmate's chat.

crew_onboarding_primary_pick_engine_back: Hint above the disabled Open chat button when no engine was picked.
crew_onboarding_primary_pick_engine_reas: Hint above the disabled Continue button of the engine step.
crew_onboarding_ready_hero_crewmate_name: Name of the example crewmate in the last step's art; shown in bold before the line that says it is online.
crew_onboarding_ready_hero_greeting: First chat bubble of the example crewmate in the last step's art.
crew_onboarding_ready_hero_online: Tooltip of the green dot on the example crewmate's face.
crew_onboarding_ready_hero_online_captio: Caption of the last step's art, after the bold name of the example crewmate.
crew_onboarding_skip: Button of the onboarding top bar: closes the onboarding without finishing it.
crew_onboarding_ssh_host_picker_connects: Hint under the picked server; {command} is the ssh command the alias stands for, for example ssh box.
Hint under the picked server that has its own key; {command} is the ssh command, {key} the key file path.
crew_onboarding_ssh_host_picker_empty: Text shown in the server picker when the search matches nothing.
crew_onboarding_ssh_host_picker_from_you: Label of the picker of servers found in the user's ~/.ssh/config.
crew_onboarding_ssh_host_picker_placehol: Placeholder of the picker of servers found in the user's ~/.ssh/config; {count} is how many it lists.
crew_onboarding_ssh_host_picker_search: Placeholder of the search field inside the server picker.
crew_onboarding_story_approval_text: Third line of the how-it-works story: detail.
crew_onboarding_story_approval_title: Third line of the how-it-works story: title.
crew_onboarding_story_order_text: First line of the how-it-works story: detail.
crew_onboarding_story_order_title: First line of the how-it-works story: title.
crew_onboarding_story_results_text: Fourth line of the how-it-works story: detail.
crew_onboarding_story_results_title: Fourth line of the how-it-works story: title.
crew_onboarding_story_server_text: Second line of the how-it-works story: detail.
crew_onboarding_story_server_title: Second line of the how-it-works story: title; it is the crewmate.
